selectionRules.tieBreak: seed ascending, actual time ascending, anchor index ascending; candidate ties use eventId ascending.
selectionRules.BOnlyDominated: B-only option count is positive and at least each of C-only and mixed {B,C}; among qualifying slots maximize B-only share, then earliest slot.
selectionRules.COnlyDominated: C-only option count is positive and at least each of B-only and mixed {B,C}; among qualifying slots maximize C-only share, then earliest slot.
selectionRules.disjointMaximum: Maximize pairwise disjoint unique-X option pairs; ties use more options then earliest slot.

cases.criterion: Earliest slot with exactly one unique spatial X option.
Maximum unique spatial X option count; tie by earliest slot.
Maximum pairwise disjoint X option pairs; then more options; then earliest slot.
Slot with highest B-only share among slots where B-only count is the largest provenance class.
Slot with highest C-only share among slots where C-only count is the largest provenance class.
Earliest slot with a same-X {B,C} option and at least one other distinct X.
Maximum mature age among candidates in a slot with more than one unique spatial option.
